title: Installation of the Inboard Flap Carriage Roller and Bearing Assembly

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the roller and bearing assembly on the inboard flap carriage, with the pairing rule between roller profile and track surface and the clearance check against the flap position sensing bracket.

sections.purpose: This task installs the roller and bearing assembly on the inboard flap carriage, sets the carriage clearance and confirms by functional test that the flap runs without binding through the full range.
sections.job_setup_note: Roller and track must be paired. A crowned roller runs only on a nitrided full-width track and a cylindrical roller runs only on an induction-hardened track; the wrong pairing destroys the roller within a few hundred cycles. Check the track marking before you open the kit. The crowned roller sits 1.2 millimetres higher in the track, which changes the flap rigging datum.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the track standard from the marking at the inboard end and select the matching roller. CAUTION: DO NOT FIT A CROWNED ROLLER TO AN INDUCTION-HARDENED TRACK. CONTACT STRESS AT THE HARDNESS EDGE WILL PIT THE TRACK IN LESS THAN 500 CYCLES. 2. Clean the bearing bore and the pivot faces. 3. Position the roller and bearing assembly in the carriage. 4. Install the bolts AGS968429-4D at the carriage pivot and torque them to the value in the referenced data. 5. Fit the bearing cover with the screws LN714541-64. 6. Re-route the hose GR458189-31 clear of the roller envelope and secure it. 7. Refit the heat exchanger bracket D2750134493366 as the carriage spacer. 8. Measure the clearance between the roller envelope and the bracket of the flap position sensing valve at FIN 3416KS4 and confirm it is at least 40 millimetres. WARNING: A CLEARANCE BELOW THE LIMIT WILL LET THE ROLLER CONTACT THE SENSING BRACKET AT FULL EXTENSION AND CAN GIVE A FALSE FLAP POSITION. 9. Restore hydraulic power and remove the carriage restraint and the trestles. 10. Do the flap operational test through the full range and listen for binding. 11. Do the flap position indication check at every detent.
sections.close_out: Close the trailing edge access panels and confirm the fastener torque. Remove the warning notices and the tooling from the area. Record the roller part standard, the measured clearance and the functional test result against the aircraft, and enter the roller change in the component history.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the crowned roller applies only to aircraft with a nitrided track

safety_precautions: Confirm the track standard before you fit the roller.
Keep the carriage restraint fitted until the pivot is torqued.
Restore hydraulic power only after the trestles are clear.
Keep clear of the flap during the operational test.
